question: Can complete paragraphs be jointly assigned exact historical source runs under one global injective whole-word code?
source_pool: Exactly8 ALIM Medicina works/versions returned by the frozen official catalog query, plus six existing COREMA recipe XMLs; source.py defines edition-level intact units and Unicode NFC/lower L-M-N tokenization. All source hashes bound. No typo correction, gap bridging, abbreviation expansion or post-fit corpus additions. Related witnesses are dependent.
target: Reuse GDT887 SELECTED.json, all inherited eligible complete paragraphs on odd physical fNN leaves, separately ZL3b/IT2a/RF1b/CONSENSUS. Raw complete groups only. No new minimum length, repeated-type count, clipping, uncertain-group deletion, or paragraph regrouping. Existing eligibility is deliberately inherited, including its stricter STA checks.
exposure: All target material has historical project exposure. This session inspected cache schema/one odd paragraph eligibility only before freezing; the complete JSON file was decoded for schema inspection, but even-leaf bodies were not inspected or used for design. Fitter receives a separately written odd-only packet. Even leaves are not scored here; no claim of historically untouched data.
source_run: Each selected whole target paragraph equals exactly one contiguous token run within one frozen source unit. Every source window of the complete target length is eligible. No source-unit crossing. Different target paragraphs may select different source units/offsets; no source-order inference.
writing_model: One global partial bijection between exact complete ciphertext groups and normalized written source words; all selected paragraphs must agree forward and reverse. No character key, root morphology, homophony, word omissions, synonym replacements or per-paragraph keys. A homograph is one written plaintext form; semantic identity is not established.
objective: Maximize total written word positions covered by complete target paragraphs. At most one source reading per target paragraph; unselected paragraphs remain untranslated. Retain every optimum; source witnesses with identical paragraph projection/maps may be collapsed only with all provenance retained.
identified_projection: A paragraph is forced only if it is selected in every optimum with the identical complete plaintext. A codeword is forced only if all optimum global maps contain it with the same written value. Both are conditional on this model and source pool, not confirmed meanings.
completeness: Source-window enumeration and optimization must both exhaust before COMPLETE. Runtime/memory exhaustion yields UNKNOWN_BUDGET; best found weight is a lower bound, never unique or rejected. No arbitrary solution cap.
future_gates: No null score, relation evidence promotion or semantic claim in this discovery. Future null must change cross-paragraph identities rather than globally rename words, retain appropriate marginal structure and pass GDT388 mobile/provenance/capacity/held gates. Future held decoding may add neither a key value nor a newly selected source passage.
decision: Forced full paragraphs warrant independent source collation and a frozen continuation test. Zero compatible paragraphs or only ambiguous optima park this exact-copy pool/model; no automatic corpus enlargement or key repair.

budget.includes: preparation, implementation, independent validation and publication

claim_ceiling: Exploratory corpus-relative reconstruction only; zero confirmed meaning without independent gates.
